hooks.text: One sleeping black hole flared fifty times brighter than the Crab Nebula.
A sleeping black hole became the brightest X-ray beacon in our sky.
The sky's fiercest high-energy monster spent twenty-six years completely silent.

title: The Sleeping Black Hole That Outshone the Sky
description: V404 Cygni spent decades silently feeding on a companion star before waking up to unleash record-shattering X-ray blasts and wobbling relativistic jets.

beats.text: One sleeping black hole flared fifty times brighter than the Crab Nebula.
beats.visual: artist's concept of black hole V404 Cygni erupting with bright accretion disk, 2015

beats.text: Located about 8,000 light-years away, V404 Cygni holds a black hole nine to ten times our Sun's mass.
beats.visual: wide-field telescopic view of the Cygnus constellation showing star fields, 2020

beats.text: Every 6.5 days, a companion star orbits closely, feeding gas into a swelling accretion disk.
beats.visual: diagram of a stellar-mass black hole drawing matter from a companion star, 2019
queries: black hole binary accretion disk diagram

beats.text: After recorded outbursts in 1938 and 1956, Japan's Ginga satellite detected another awakening in 1989.
beats.visual: model illustration of the Japanese Ginga X-ray astronomy satellite in orbit, 1987

beats.text: Then, after twenty-six years of slumber, NASA's Swift satellite caught it erupting in June 2015.
beats.visual: artist's rendering of NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory in Earth orbit, 2004

beats.text: Extreme gravitational frame-dragging warped space-time, forcing its inner disk to wobble like a dying top.
beats.visual: animation still of space-time warping and tilted accretion disk precession, 2019

beats.text: Terrifyingly, relativistic plasma jets sprayed high-energy bullets in wildly changing directions within minutes.
beats.visual: artist's visualization of precessing relativistic jets shooting from V404 Cygni, 2019
queries: precessing jet black hole ICRAR illustration

beats.text: Decades of silence can shatter in seconds whenever this cosmic predator awakens.
beats.visual: composite X-ray and optical image of the high-energy sky and Cygnus region, 2015
queries: V404 Cygni outburst optical X-ray composite

better_than_last: Applies proven learnings by opening with a high-tension record hook rather than a passive catalog name, cutting historical timeline drag, and using an open concluding loop.
